# sourcefile

```go
import "github.com/lucasavila00/tgo/internal/sourcefile"
```

Package sourcefile maps TGo inputs to Go output filenames. It keeps platform and test suffixes where Go build selection expects them.

## func GeneratedName

```go
func GeneratedName(source string) string
```

GeneratedName keeps Go build and test suffixes after the output marker.

## func InputName

```go
func InputName(output string) string
```

InputName returns the TGo input path for a generated Go filename. An empty result means the filename does not follow the output naming rule.
